hypotheses.P1_additive_paths_explain_full: For oracle and hierarchical routes, the sum of direct and attention hybrid logit effects has median Fisher fidelity at least 0.80 on both corpora.
hypotheses.P2_no_single_path_is_sufficient: For the oracle route, neither direct nor attention hybrid alone reaches median Fisher fidelity 0.80 on either corpus.
hypotheses.P3_immediate_interaction_is_small: For oracle and hierarchical routes, the median layer-9 direct/attention interaction energy is at most 25% of the full layer-9 effect energy on both corpora.
hypotheses.P4_hierarchical_error_is_attention_heavy: The hierarchical-to-oracle fidelity of the direct hybrid exceeds that of the attention hybrid by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.P5_flat_improves_both_paths: Flat-256 has at least as much route-to-oracle Fisher fidelity as hierarchical-128 for both direct and attention hybrids on both corpora.
